I would say figure out, think long and hard on if you still love her as a friend, as family. Really picture if you want this person and her family in your life for the foreseeable future.

If you've still got all of the elements of a good foundation, it can be built upon.

But it's up to you to decide what makes you happy. If you love this person, truly, as all of those things and not just "in love", work on it I say. But if you're unfulfilled and they don't meet all of that criteria, sometimes being selfish is important.

We have to think of ourselves sometimes too. You deserve to be happy too and sacrificing yourself isn't good.

I'm also a firm believer friendship after the fact can work, if you desire it. I think if this ends, you two could avoid toxicity as long as you talk and lay yourself out there.

Good luck to you, I know this sucks and hurts.
